text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x provides financial aid.
GREApplicant(x) ::: x applies to take the GRE test.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x has economic hardship.
Difficulty(x) ::: x experiences difficulty due to lack of resources or money.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FatherOutOfWorkLong(x) ::: x's father has been out of work for more than a year.

Premises:
∃x (FinancialAid(x) ∧ GREApplicant(x)) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or resources.
Tom lives in a single-parent family. His dad has been out of work for more than a year. ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family and his father has been out of work for over a year.

Conclusion:
GREApplicant(tom) → FinancialAid(tom) ::: If Tom applies to take the GRE test, then he can apply for financial aid.
